market.audience: Beginning and improving contract bridge players who want to bid, declare and defend with more confidence
market.problem: Bridge rules are broad, but the table demands a specific bid or play before a player feels ready
market.advantage: Bridge Trainer turns Standard American foundations, bidding, declarer play and defense into short explained drills with mastery tracking
market.competitive_context: It competes with full bridge games and broad lesson libraries. It wins on low-pressure practice for the exact decisions that feel hardest at the table

proof_points.claim: Name Your Opening deals a hand and asks for the opening call
Your Progress shows accuracy and per-room mastery
How to Play explains partnerships with card faces

story.throughline: Move from bridge uncertainty to confident bids and plays through short explained practice on the iPhone Duo outer display
